rules.statement: Gate a deployment job that promotes to a hosted environment with a deployment environment (`environment:`) that has its own required reviewers and secrets, not just a branch condition.
rules.why: A branch conveys no approval and leaves no audit record. An environment gate records the approval decision against the deployment instead of implying it from a merge.
rules.check: In CI/CD workflow diffs, look for deploy or promote jobs that rely only on `if: github.ref == ...` or branch triggers, have no `environment:` key, or read deployment secrets from repository-level secrets instead of environment-scoped ones.

rules.statement: Trigger CI workflows on the `main` trunk and on pull requests targeting `main`, and don't name a long-lived integration branch (such as `dev` or `master`) in workflow triggers, image tags or deployment gates.
rules.why: The repository develops on a single trunk with no integration branch. A workflow that names an integration branch points at a branch that gets no commits, and builds from it would not match `publicReleaseRefSpec`.
rules.check: Look for workflow `on.push.branches` or `on.pull_request.branches` entries, or tag/deploy conditions, that reference `dev`, `develop` or `master` instead of `main` (release branches `release/v*` and version tags are allowed).
